@@ -0,0 +1,20 @@ +

. services/shared drops its unused Redis cache section and keeps the types billing vendors (KS-657)

+
What this changes. Blockchain/Dev/services/shared (@secuura/service-utils), on Kam’s ruling of 2026-11-06 (card secuura-ks-657-dead-shared-cache-code-1106 = a: “Delete the cache section; keep the types”), with the file list drawn by Wednesday (ANSWER 2026-11-06 05:40:48Z, option A, tier 1). Deleted: src/cache/ (5 files, 1,434 lines), src/security/redis-security-store.ts (417 lines; it imports ../cache/redis-client, so the cache cannot go without it), the two re-exports (export * from './cache' in src/index.ts, the store’s export block in src/security/index.ts), and the six KS-1868 tests that pinned them (3 cache files, 3 stores; 32 cells). Kept: types/, src/security/{audit,headers,rate-limiter,validation}.ts, src/utils/logger.ts, the three validation tests. package.json and the lock are untouched, so ioredis stays declared and now unused. services/redis.ts (outside src/, never compiled) is not deleted; it is listed under what was not covered. No runtime behaviour changes: nothing imports the deleted code. +
One cell outside the package moves on purpose. packages/shared/src/__tests__/ks1725-zod3-compat.test.ts line 394 asserted that its walk over the product source of services/ and packages/ found more than 500 files, so the walker cannot go blind. The walk read 506 files at develop and reads 500 after this change (both measured, by a temporary probe patch restored by sha256). Six deleted files take it to equality, so the floor moves to toBeGreaterThan(494): the same six-file slack. Wednesday ruled it (ANSWER 05:48:54Z). The census is 268 of 268 before and after. +
+

.1 What proves it

+
Red with only the new test file, green with the deletion. New file ks657-the-dead-cache-section-is-gone.test.ts, 7 cells over the file system and source text. At develop c5c26b2835df with the new cells alone: 4 of 7 fail, all by AssertionError (the folder, the store and both re-exports are still there, and the store imports a path into the cache); the 3 controls pass (the kept files exist, billing’s COPY services/shared/types/ line and types/svs-types.ts are intact, the import scan flags a planted re-export). With the deletion: 7 of 7 pass. +
Builds and suites. services/shared npm run build: exit 0 at develop and exit 0 after, with no cache or redis file in dist. Its unit suite: 9 files / 45 cells at develop; 4 files / 20 cells, 20 pass after, on three runs (45 − 32 deleted + 7 new). Billing, which vendors types/: npm run build exit 0 before and after; its suite 20 files / 377 cells before and after. Mutants: 8 of 8 killed (the cache re-export back in either index, one cache file back, the store back, a kept security file deleted, types/svs-types.ts deleted, billing’s COPY line altered, a kept file importing the deleted client); four of them (either re-export, the deleted audit.ts, the import in a kept file) make npm run build exit 2. Each file restored by content and checked by sha256. +
The frame of “nothing imports it”. Searched at develop c5c26b2835df: every tracked file, for a relative path into services/shared/src or the name @secuura/service-utils: no code import; the hits are notes and docs, the frontends’ ../shared/src (that is frontend/shared), and path strings in packages/shared’s zod census, which name validation.ts and audit.ts (both kept). Of 37 Dockerfiles, 15 compose files and 17 workflows (and the bicep and build scripts), the only line that copies from services/shared is services/billing/Dockerfile:47, COPY services/shared/types/; scripts/build-docker.sh:7 names the folder in a comment. Positive control: the same style of search finds billing’s live types/ import and that COPY line. Outside the frame: consumers outside this repository and files that are not tracked. +
+

.2 Environment and figures

+
Measured 2026-11-06 (UTC) on an Apple Silicon (arm64) Mac, macOS 27.2, shared with other seats, in-process tests with no Docker stack. Develop c5c26b2835df with the change on top. TypeScript 5.9.3, vitest 4.1.12, eslint 10.7.0. tsc on the service config: 0 errors; with the test files in the program: 0 errors, and a planted type error was reported as TS2322. eslint --max-warnings 0 on the 3 changed TypeScript files and the census file: clean, and a planted file raised no-constant-condition. Node v26.8.1 is not an LTS line, so these results were not measured on an LTS runtime. +
+

.3 What this does not prove

+
No running stack. Nothing was started; no image was built (billing was built with tsc, not as a Docker image). Out-of-repository consumers of @secuura/service-utils are not measured. services/redis.ts is not deleted (the card did not reach it; a candidate for its own ticket). The card’s “15 files” is the whole src/ tree at the ticket’s date (13 sources and 2 tests at 74a330fc0), not the cache section (5 files). The four platform suites were not run. +
No deploy is owed: nothing runs this package. The ticket stays In Review. +
+

.4 Running it

+
cd Blockchain/Dev/services/shared && npx vitest run src/__tests__/ks657-the-dead-cache-section-is-gone.test.ts   # 7 cells
+cd Blockchain/Dev/services/shared && npx vitest run && npm run build                                           # 4 files / 20 cells, build exit 0
+cd Blockchain/Dev/packages/shared && npm test -- src/__tests__/ks1725-zod3-compat.test.ts                      # 268 cells
